english: The horse that eats sugar, honey, and fried rice and has a good aroma is said to be clean and belonging to the brahmin class. The horse that belongs to the warrior class would be lustrous, meek and clever. If the above qualities are found in lesser proportions it is known as the vaiśya class. The horse that is impure, unsteady, dull, ugly, foolish and wicked is said to belong to the śūdra class.
